items.h: Haymitch Gets His Origin Story as Hunger Games Returns to Theaters
items.sum: Sunrise on the Reaping is in theaters, with trackers betting it opens bigger than any Hunger Games film in a decade.

items.h: The Newport Nutcracker Returns to Rosecliff Mansion for Late November
items.sum: Newport Contemporary Ballet dances its ballroom Nutcracker on Nov. 25, 27 and 28 at Rosecliff in Newport.

items.h: Warwick Symphony Orchestra Marks 60 Years With a Holiday Celebration
items.sum: A Dec. 13 Diamond Jubilee concert in North Kingstown, with recorder soloist Michael Raymond.

items.h: The Chorus of Westerly Brings Its Christmas Pops to George Kent Hall
items.sum: Holiday favorites, new and old, on Sunday, Dec. 20, at 5:30 p.m. in Westerly.

items.h: Warren's Holiday Festival Lights Up Main Street on Nov. 27
items.sum: A town-wide Friday of holiday events in downtown Warren, ending with the Main Street tree lighting.

items.h: Cushing's Rediscovered Paintings Go on View in Newport
items.sum: Newport Art Museum reunites paintings by Howard Gardiner Cushing in a gallery show that runs through 2027.

items.h: Blithewold's Christmas Brings Sparkle Lights to Bristol
items.sum: Nature-themed holiday displays and evening Sparkle lights run Tuesday through Sunday at the Bristol mansion through Jan. 3.

items.h: 150 Vendors Open the Holiday Season in West Warwick
items.sum: The Rhode Island Christmas Festival runs Nov. 21 and 22 at the West Warwick Civic Center with entertainment and food trucks.

items.h: Peace Dale Church Hosts 63rd Annual Christmas Bazaar
items.sum: Shoppers can browse a white elephant sale, local crafts and a homemade lunch at Peace Dale Congregational Church on Dec. 5.

items.h: Newport Art Museum Hosts a Collage Workshop and a Printmaking Demo
items.sum: Writing-and-collage workshop Saturday, Nov. 21, and a printmaking demonstration Sunday, Nov. 22, at the Newport Art Museum.

items.h: Westerly Library's December: Stained Glass, Gingerbread and a Talk
items.sum: A stained-glass exhibition, a gingerbread contest and an author talk fill the library's first weeks of December in Westerly.

items.h: Ocean State Artisans' Holiday Market Opens in Wakefield
items.sum: Handmade goods and a food drive at South Kingstown High School on Nov. 27 and 28.

items.h: State Ballet of Rhode Island's Coppélia Dances at RIC on Dec. 12
items.sum: A holiday ballet of love and mischief with life-sized dancing dolls, one performance on Saturday, Dec. 12 at 2 p.m. in Roberts Hall, Providence.

items.h: Alicia Keys' Hell's Kitchen Runs at PPAC Dec. 15 Through 20
items.sum: The Broadway musical comes to Providence's PPAC for a run in mid-December.

items.h: Cirque du Soleil's 'Twas the Night Before Plays PPAC Through Dec. 6
items.sum: The holiday show is on stage at PPAC through early December.

items.h: RICCO Brings Handel's Messiah to All Saints in Providence
items.sum: Two December performances feature the Brown University Chorus and the chorale's professional orchestra.

items.h: Foundry Artists' Holiday Show Brings 65 Artists to Pawtucket
items.sum: Thursday, Dec. 3 at the Pawtucket Armory Center for the Arts, with original art and handmade gifts from 65 artists.

items.h: Christmas in the Valley Brings Fine Art and Craft to Foster
items.sum: Friday, Nov. 27 through Sunday, Nov. 29 at the Foster Country Club, with fine art and fine craft exhibitors and no food booths.

items.h: A Live Radio Play of It's a Wonderful Life Comes to Woonsocket
items.sum: Dec. 3 through Dec. 6 at the Stadium Theatre, with a cast of a few dozen telling George Bailey's story as a 1940s radio broadcast.

items.h: Frozen Thaws Woonsocket's Stadium Theatre With a Broadway Musical
items.sum: Four performances from Friday, Nov. 20 at 7:30 p.m. through Sunday, Nov. 22 at 2 p.m. at the Stadium Theatre, 28 Monument Square, Woonsocket.

items.h: Newport's Jessica Hagen Gallery Opens Its 21st Holiday Show
items.sum: The annual holiday exhibition opens with a reception from 5 to 7 PM on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 9A Bridge Street in Newport.

items.h: Trinity Rep's A Christmas Carol Celebrates Its 50th Anniversary
items.sum: Trinity Repertory Company's 50th-anniversary A Christmas Carol runs through Dec. 31 at the Dowling Theater in Providence, directed by Taavon Gamble.

items.h: RISD Museum's Barkan Ceramics Show Runs Through March 2028
items.sum: More than 100 works from the Barkan Contemporary Ceramic Collection are on view now at the RISD Museum in Providence.

items.h: Bowen's Wharf Lights Up Newport With Its 56th Christmas Tree Lighting
items.sum: Santa arrives, local musicians and choruses perform, and the tree lights at 6 PM on Dec. 5.

items.h: Bristol's Christmas Festival Returns to Unity Park on Dec. 5 and 6
items.sum: Two days of live music, food trucks, a tree lighting and an outdoor market at no charge.

items.h: North Providence Library's Holiday Bazaar Brings 30 Vendors on Dec. 5
items.sum: Handmade goods, Santa and the Grinch, live music and a thrift store at the library.

items.h: Xpeng Puts Its Iron Humanoid on Stage Wednesday. The Clock Is Ticking
items.sum: The Chinese EV maker's AI Day on Nov. 25 is its last big show before its own deadline to mass-produce a walking robot.

items.h: The Fockers Crash Thanksgiving, Up Against Disney and Haymitch
items.sum: Focker-In-Law opens Wednesday against Disney's Hexed and a second weekend of the new Hunger Games.

items.h: Waymo Takes the Exit: Robotaxis Pulled Off Highways in Five Metros
items.sum: After California called its driverless highway runs a public safety hazard, Waymo stopped highway rides everywhere it offered them, with no restart date.
